description:
Hi! I'm Vansh - Erasmus Master's student, a background in Electrical Engineering and couple of  years of software engineering experience at Amazon and Nvidia. I have experience in Python, machine learning, time-series forecasting and backend development. 

I'm interested in using NASA satellite data and AI to help farmers adapt to climate change. Looking for teammates with skills in agriculture, GIS, geospatial data, satellite imagery and frontend development. Let's build something impactful!
